name: spray-record
title: Spray application record
for_each: select id, name from crops where exists (select 1 from applications a where a.crop_id = crops.id)

sections.title: Applications
sections.sql: select applied_on, start_time, finish_time, product, rate_per_ha, area_ha, total_qty, unit, water_l_ha, target, operator, equipment, wind_kmh, wind_dir, temp_c, harvest_clear, reentry_clear, label_ref from application_register where id in (select id from applications where crop_id = $1) order by applied_on
sections.note: Working record for the farm. The label and the rules in your state or region govern the actual application.

name: recommendation
title: Agronomy recommendation
for_each: select distinct c.id, c.name from crops c join recommendations r on r.crop_id = c.id where r.status = 'open'

sections.title: Open recommendations
sections.sql: select product, rate_per_ha, unit, qty_needed, stock, due, recommended_by, reason, decision from recommendation_board where crop = (select name from crops where id = $1) and status = 'open' order by due

sections.title: Label checks before mixing
sections.sql: select distinct p.name, p.mode_group, p.whp_days, p.rei_hours, p.max_rate_per_ha, p.label_ref from recommendations r join products p on p.id = r.product_id where r.crop_id = $1 and r.status = 'open'
sections.note: Demonstration values. Confirm every figure on the actual label.

sections.title: Farm
sections.sql: select name, country, region, owner, spray_plan_review from farms where id = $1

sections.title: Spray diary
sections.sql: select crop, product, applied_on, start_time, finish_time, rate_per_ha, area_ha, operator, equipment, target, wind_kmh, wind_dir, harvest_clear, record_lag_hours from application_register where farm = (select name from farms where id = $1) order by applied_on

sections.title: Harvests
sections.sql: select c.name crop, h.harvested_on, h.tonnes, h.moisture_pct, h.destination, h.reference from harvests h join crops c on c.id = h.crop_id join fields f on f.id = c.field_id where f.farm_id = $1 order by h.harvested_on
sections.note: A working pack for the owner and auditor. It does not certify compliance.
